data.name: Ham
data.gender_notes: Ham is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Ham is of Hebrew origin and means 'hot' or 'dry'. In the biblical story of Noah's Ark, Ham is the eldest son of Noah and his wife, who disgraced himself and his family by looking upon his father's nakedness during Noah's drunken sleep. Despite this, Ham is later blessed by Noah and becomes the ancestor of the Canaanites. Ham's story serves as a reminder of the importance of respecting one's parents and the consequences of disobedience.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents disobedience and the importance of respecting authority.
data.etymology: Ham belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Eldest son of Noah.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ham total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
